name: 两个名字 · 人物传 VOL.5（高级）
desc: 2026 暑假特辑 SP6《两个名字》高级档（陷阱猎人版）语法命门 12 题。本卷的看图命门（13–18）、传记阅读（19–22）、词梯、辨笔迹区依赖纸面主图与机关，未进题库。

m5.q: Nobody could tell Mr Wolf where Jin ___ at that moment.
m5.why: 主句 could tell 是过去时，宾语从句时态要跟着退回过去；at that moment 也指当时。

m5.q: — Where is Xi? — She ___ the illusion world. She isn't back yet.
m5.why: has gone to =“去了还没回来”，与 She isn't back yet 完全咬合。

m5.q: Xi ___ every coin in the jar on snacks that afternoon.
m5.why: 人作主语，spend + 钱 + on + 物，花钱买零食。

m5.q: Jin still remembers Xi ___ her hair for the first time years ago.
m5.why: remember doing 表示“记得做过的事”，多年前编发是已经发生的记忆。

m5.q: Xi seldom says sorry with her mouth, ___?
m5.why: seldom 带否定意味，前半句算否定句，反义疑问用肯定 does she。

m5.q: Jin ___ be the quietest girl in class — or so everyone thought.
m5.why: used to do =“过去常常是/曾经是”，现在不是了——正合“大家以前都这么以为”。

m5.q: In that world, whatever is done ___ in the end, but whatever is written remains.
m5.why: 做过的事是“被擦除”的，主语是事不是人，用一般现在时被动表规则。
感叹的中心是名词 handwriting（不可数），用 What + 形容词 + 不可数名词。

m5.q: One of them borrowed a quiet name, and ___ borrowed a loud one.
m5.why: 一共只有两个人，one… the other… 表示“一个……另一个……”。

m5.q: The trick seemed too perfect ___ — until the handwriting spoke.
m5.why: too + 形容词 + to do，“完美得不可能失败”。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: Xi's handwriting is more better than anyone else's.
The coins were put back into the jar.
Jin is one of the few girls who keep long hair in the class.
Xi herself does not know how strong her writing is.
m5.why: better 本身已是比较级，前面不能再加 more → Xi's handwriting is better than…。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: Xi was made to clean the study in the real world.
Jin found it hard to say the word aloud.
The new pen was paid for with Jin's own coins.
The illusion was ended by itself when the hour was up.
m5.why: by itself（自行）只能配主动——The illusion ended by itself；“被自己结束”自相矛盾。
